items.title: Zcash Developer Zakura Proposes Fix to Stop Quantum Computers Linking Shielded Swaps
items.desc: Zakura says a single published Zcash address could let a future quantum attacker link every payment a wallet has ever received.

items.title: US Bitcoin ETFs draw $527M in biggest showing since September
items.desc: BlackRock’s IBIT led the gains with $665.2 million in inflows, offsetting withdrawals from Fidelity and Grayscale, while other funds recorded no net flows.

items.title: Blockchain Association says Treasury’s GENIUS Act rollout needs clearer DeFi, foreign issuer rules
items.desc: The group filed comments on Treasury's proposed rule implementing the GENIUS Act, which governs who can issue and sell payment stablecoins.

items.title: Ramp Seeks OCC Trust Bank Charter for Digital Asset Custody
items.desc: The proposed bank would not take deposits or make commercial loans; Ramp says it would build products alongside its banking partners.

items.title: Aster Sets PAPER Perp Delisting After Transferability Decision
items.desc: Paragon had already halted its PAPER market and settled open positions at $0.026296 after Papertrade ruled out token transfers for now.

items.title: Bitcoin rally could revive treasury buying, but easy-money days over
items.desc: “A return to last year’s indiscriminate capital raising looks unlikely,” said Bitfinex head of derivatives Jag Kooner.

items.title: Super League Shareholders Back Metaplanet’s 2,100 BTC Investment
items.desc: The gaming-media company plans to become Superplanet, a Nasdaq-listed US Bitcoin treasury platform, with closing expected in Q4 2026.

items.title: Papertrade Keeps PAPER Non-Transferable, Citing Perp Attack Risks
items.desc: Holders who earned PAPER through trading losses can stake it for USDC distributions, but still have no date when they can transfer or sell their tokens.

items.title: Arcus Adds Stock Tokens and WETH as Perpetual Collateral
items.desc: The early-access feature uses automatic USDG loans at 50% initial loan-to-value, with non-USDG deposits capped at $20,000 per account.

items.title: BlackRock files for bitcoin ETF offering downside protection and upside exposure to IBIT
items.desc: One of the world's largest investment managers, BlackRock has filed for another bitcoin fund, marking its third tied to the asset.

items.title: Strive Buys $335 Million in Bitcoin After Investors Pour In $369 Million
items.desc: The Nasdaq-listed bitcoin holder bought as warrant holders exercised, bringing in $369 million, and it now plans a $630 million sale of 15% preferred stock.

items.title: Anthropic Gives 5% of Itself to the Public. Musk Answers by Giving Away SpaceX Shares
items.desc: Anthropic committed 5% of its shares to a public benefit fund, and within hours Elon Musk promised a SpaceX share to every American child.

items.title: XRP Ledger Repairs Its Lending Protocol Before It Goes Live
items.desc: XRP developers published a second amendment to repair the ledger’s new uncollateralized lending feature while the original still awaits validator approval.

items.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
items.desc: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

items.desc: The Morpho vault lends against cbBTC collateral, but nearly all its assets remain idle rather than deployed into loans.

items.title: Market participants weigh in on SEC’s proposed crypto regulations
items.desc: The financial agency is scheduled to close public comments on its ‘Regulation Crypto Assets’ proposed in August.

items.title: Hackers Are Running Apple's iOS on Android Phones for the First Time
items.desc: Hobbyists are booting iOS 16 on Xiaomi and Nothing phones and posting the proof. It barely works, but it suggests Apple's software is no longer welded to Apple's hardware.

items.title: Visa, Mesh partner to enable crypto spending at 175M merchant locations
items.desc: Mesh will connect crypto and stablecoin wallets to Visa’s global payment network, allowing users to spend digital assets without a separate card.

items.title: Mastercard Brings Its Fraud-Fighting Tools to Stablecoin Payments
items.desc: Unveiled at Money20/20, the API-based tool combines payment and blockchain intelligence to flag fraud, scams and sanctions exposure before funds move on-chain.

items.title: France’s Stablecoin Swap Tax Faces Oct. 20 Budget Vote
items.desc: Deputies approved the amendment by one vote. If enacted, it would end tax deferral for conversions into single-currency e-money tokens from January 2027.

items.title: Mastercard launches stablecoin risk screening for banks and payment providers
items.desc: The new service combines payment data and blockchain analytics to help banks detect suspicious stablecoin transactions before settlement.

items.title: Why Some of America’s Biggest Companies Are Objecting to Tokenized Shares
items.desc: Nine companies, including Verizon, Broadcom and UnitedHealth, have objected to having their shares traded on the planned OKX-ICE tokenized stock venue.

items.title: US Orders Civilian Agencies to Rip DeepSeek Out of Government Systems
items.desc: The Department of Homeland Security told civilian agencies to remove China's DeepSeek and any service built on it, and banned buying more, citing the risk of sensitive data reaching Beijing.

items.title: Rain Says Western Union's Stablecard Is Live in 37 Markets
items.desc: The USDPT-backed Visa card is getting a Money20/20 promotion offering up to $40 in purchase-only credits, subject to in-person signup and approval.

items.title: JPMorgan's JPM Coin Arrives on Ethereum, Putting Bank Dollars on a Public Blockchain
items.desc: JPMorgan is rolling out JPM Coin on Ethereum for institutional clients, a token backed by dollars in its accounts that settles in seconds, any day of the week.

items.title: Revolut secures Gibraltar crypto license to support global expansion
items.desc: The UK-based fintech will use the authorization to offer crypto services in additional international markets, though it has not disclosed specific countries or launch dates.

items.title: Lighter Launches BTC and ETH Binary Options on Core
items.desc: The Up/Down contracts pay winning shares 1 USDC and require full funding, with no leverage or liquidations.

items.title: Abandoned Bitcoin? Wallet Targeted by Noah Doe Lawsuit Moves $33 Million
items.desc: A Bitcoin address dormant since 2013 moved 411.45 BTC worth about $33.4 million, according to Galaxy Research, and it’s among the wallets named in the “Noah Doe” lawsuit.

items.title: Metaplanet to take 93.7% stake in Super League through 2,100 BTC deal
items.desc: The transaction would give Metaplanet access to US capital markets, where it plans to use preferred stock offerings to finance additional Bitcoin purchases.

items.title: Frax Announces Six-Currency FX Lineup on Aerodrome
items.desc: The six Base pools held about $241,000 in liquidity and recorded roughly $20,000 in trading over 24 hours, according to GeckoTerminal data.

items.title: Coinbase Partners With Thunes for Bank and Mobile-Wallet Payouts
items.desc: Coinbase will supply stablecoin infrastructure while Thunes adds local payout connections; the partners have not specified launch timing or markets.

items.title: Strive buys $335M in Bitcoin, boosting holdings to 36,818 BTC
items.desc: The Bitcoin treasury company added another 1,223 BTC after an earlier purchase pushed it past MARA Holdings, while continuing to expand its reserves through equity financing.

items.title: SharpLink Says It Deployed $400 Million Across Ether.fi and Lido
items.desc: The company describes both allocations as deployed, following its August plan to stake $200 million through Lido and hold wstETH with Anchorage.

items.title: Mesh taps Visa to let users spend crypto without a separate card
items.desc: Mesh and Visa will let users spend crypto and stablecoin balances from wallet apps, with no need to sell or transfer assets first.

items.title: Bitcoin is rejected at $83K as US bond yields reverse higher with equities
items.desc: Bitcoin price action failed to improve with equities as a sell wall at $83,000 kept BTC in a tight range.

items.title: Mastercard unveils Stablecoin Security tool to screen payments for fraud and sanctions risks
items.desc: Mastercard unveiled Stablecoin Security, a risk screening service launching in North America before planned global availability in 2027.

items.desc: Merchants would receive fiat through Visa payments, while Mesh handles conversion. Initial availability and participating platforms have yet to be announced.

items.title: Tom Lee’s Bitmine Adds $30 Million in Ethereum as Buying Nears Its Finish Line
items.desc: The purchase lifts Bitmine’s stash to 6.04 million ETH—4.9% of supply and 99% of the way to its “Alchemy of 5%” goal—as chairman Tom Lee framed a market-wide selloff as an attractive entry point.

items.title: AnchorWatch Trust Company launches bitcoin custody service with up to $370 million in insurance per client
items.desc: AnchorWatch launched Nevada-chartered bitcoin custody with a $10,000 monthly fee cap and optional insurance of up to $370 million per client.

items.title: Sparkassen Begin Bitcoin Trading Through DekaBank in Banking App
items.desc: Deka lists five participating savings banks, with more than 230 expressing interest. Trades cost €0.99 plus a spread, and withdrawals are limited to approved custodians.

items.title: Echo Protocol Winds Down, Halting New Deposits and Borrowing
items.desc: Withdrawals and repayments remain open, but the shutdown notice gives conflicting November deadlines before collateral liquidation.

items.title: Strive scoops up another 1,223 bitcoin for $100 million as total holdings reach 36,818 BTC
items.desc: Strive paid approximately $81,734 on average per bitcoin, adding to the 2,822 BTC it had acquired earlier last week.

items.title: Bitmine adds 12,535 ETH as treasury reaches 6.04 million tokens
items.desc: Bitmine bought 12,535 ETH last week, lifting its treasury to 6.04 million tokens and total investment holdings to $15.1 billion.

items.title: Made an ‘honest’ mistake with crypto taxes? New bill offers way out
items.desc: A proposed US bill would let crypto investors correct past tax reporting mistakes through a dedicated disclosure program, with reduced penalties for eligible taxpayers.

items.title: Public companies object to OKX-ICE’s tokenized stock plan
items.desc: Nine public companies objected to having their shares offered in tokenized form by OKX and ICE, testing whether platforms can create blockchain-based markets without issuer consent.

items.desc: Onchain records show about 140 RUNE deducted from 18 node accounts. The fix is scheduled for the v3.21 upgrade around Oct. 23.

items.title: Morning Minute: Crypto Rebounds as 'Black Monday' Looms

items.title: ‘We found room for more orange’: Michael Saylor’s Strategy buys another 267 bitcoin for $22 million

items.desc: France’s National Assembly adopted a crypto tax amendment targeting certain stablecoin swaps, while separate proposals on exit taxes and self-custodial wallet reporting remain under consideration.

items.title: Chinese suspect in $75M international crime network arrested in Bangkok
items.desc: Police alleged the suspect was involved in cryptocurrency and foreign-currency exchanges for criminal groups across more than 133 accounts.
